title: Hells Angels member hospitalized for weeks after the visit

tellings.quote: and he had checked himself into the hospital for weeks

plain: A member of the Hells Angels motorcycle club is said to have checked himself into a hospital for weeks after a visit linked to a ranch famous for reports of strange events. Brandon Fugal, the owner of that ranch, known as Skinwalker Ranch, tells it on Jesse Michels's show, passing on what a witness named Erik Bard told him. He does not say exactly what happened on the visit, only that the man ended up in hospital for weeks, which would suggest the ranch's effects can follow people even after they leave.
